serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Shanice: It's not like we are ripping you off, materials for these repairs aren’t cheap. My free time is also worth something. {{wi}}Can’t say the same about Priestbot’s since he just sits around doing nothing.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I will ignore that…
Shanice: Of course, repairs are cheaper than buying new parts, but remember, there’s a limit to how much we can patch it up. We can’t turn garbage into diamonds.
You: I will remember.
Shanice: Next time you come by, make sure to bring something.
You: Sure.
You: Once again, thanks for helping me.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: That’s the least we can do to return the favor.
You: See you two next time!
